'''Sonny''' is a deceased shopkeeper in [[Freeside]] {{In|FOTV}}.

==Background==
Sonny operated a store in Freeside called [[Sonny's Sundries]], which offered various goods including [[chems]] and weapons. Sometime around July 2296, he was robbed and murdered by a man named [[Shopkeep Simon|Simon]], who had came in naked. Simon subsequently dumped Sonny's body in a trash can in the back of his store and began wearing his clothes, though they were much too small for him; he was attempting to pass himself off as Sonny, raising the prices of all of the store's goods to exorbitant sums.

==''Fallout'' TV series==
===[[The Wrangler]]===
[[Lucy MacLean]] is directed to Sonny's Sundries by [[the Ghoul]] in order to buy [[Addictol (TV series)|Addictol]] for her [[Buffout (TV series)|Buffout]] addiction. In the ensuing events, she ends up discovering Sonny's body, being confronted by Simon and figuring out what had happened, and ultimately shooting Simon in self-defense.
